post.summary: Verify email address and activate account
post.description: This endpoint verifies the user's email address using a provided verification token. If the token is valid, the user's account is activated, and a success message is returned. No access token is returned in this case.

200.description: Email verified successfully and account activated.

post.summary: Send password reset link to user's email
post.description: This endpoint accepts a user's email and sends a password reset link to that email address. The user can then use the link to reset their password.

200.description: Password reset link sent successfully to the user's email.

message.example: We have emailed your password reset link!

422.description: Validation error or invalid email address.

post.description: This endpoint resets the user's password by providing a valid reset token, the user's email, and a new password. Upon success, the user's password will be updated, and the token will be invalidated.

message.example: Your password has been reset successfully.
This password reset token is invalid or expired.

post.description: Authenticates a user and optionally generates an access token. If the user has two-factor authentication enabled, the access token is not returned, and additional verification is required.

post.summary: Validate two-factor authentication code and generate access token
post.description: This endpoint accepts a two-factor authentication (2FA) code from the user and validates it. If the code is correct, it generates and returns an access token that can be used to authenticate further requests. The API will reject any invalid or missing 2FA code with an error.
